symbols.name_en: Supply-voltage terminal, shown on the left-hand side
symbols.name_fr: Accès de tension d'alimentation, figuré côté gauche
symbols.description: Supply-voltage terminal, shown on the left-hand side. U may be followed by the polarity sign or replaced by the nominal signed value (e.g. +5 V) or a suitable mnemonic (e.g. VCC, GND).
notes: Supply terminals are not always shown.

symbols.name_en: Supply-current terminal, shown on the left-hand side
symbols.name_fr: Accès d'alimentation en courant, figuré côté gauche
symbols.description: Supply-current terminal to be connected to a source of power.
notes: Supply terminals are not always shown.

symbols.description: Supply-voltage output (symbol contains UPWR).
Supply-current output: an output that is a source of power. If it is not necessary to emphasize that it is a power output, use symbol 13-05-08.
Reference input: an input to be connected to a reference source (symbol contains *REF).

Reference output: an output that is a reference source. The asterisk shall be replaced by the symbol for the reference quantity (U, I, f, φ). If it is not necessary to emphasize that it is a reference input/output, use 13-05-07/13-05-08.
Quantity-sensing input.
Input/output for which the indicated quantity represents the information. The asterisk shall be replaced by the symbol for the quantity (U, I, f, φ).
This input represents an operand on which one or more analogue functions are performed. For analogue operands the letters X and Y should be used.
notes: May be shown without the subsidiary-connection symbol (13-04-05) if no confusion is likely.
A + or − may be added as a suffix to indicate polarity.

symbols.name_en: Terminal (left side) to be externally connected to a subsidiary circuit or circuit element
symbols.name_fr: Accès, figuré côté gauche, d'un élément du circuit auxiliaire connecté extérieurement
symbols.description: Terminal to be externally connected to a subsidiary circuit or element (symbol contains EXT; replace by e.g. RX, CX, RCX, XTAL).

symbols.name_en: Terminal (left side) of a subsidiary internal circuit or circuit component
symbols.name_fr: Accès, figuré côté gauche, d'un circuit interne auxiliaire ou d'un composant
symbols.description: Terminal of a subsidiary internal circuit or component (symbol contains INT; e.g. RINT, CINT, XTALINT).

symbols.name_en: Adjustment terminal, shown on the left-hand side
symbols.name_fr: Accès de réglage, figuré côté gauche
symbols.description: Adjustment terminal (A*). Replace A* by ADJ or the asterisk by a property/quantity indication, e.g. B bias, CL current limit, f frequency, H hysteresis, OFS offset, P power, SR slew rate, SYM symmetry, T temperature, U/V voltage, WF waveform, Z impedance, φ phase.

symbols.name_en: Compensation terminal, shown on the left-hand side
symbols.name_fr: Accès de compensation, figuré côté gauche
symbols.description: Compensation terminal C*(x). C* → CPN or a property indication; x → the property/quantity causing the compensation.
notes: For examples of use, see 13-09-03, 13-05-05 and 13-09-09.

symbols.description: Zm-input (affecting analogue input imposing its signal level).
Zm-output. Affecting analogue Zm-inputs/outputs impose their signal levels on the analogue inputs/outputs affected by them.
notes: These symbols imply dependency notation (replace m by the identifying number); see IEC 617-12, Sections 11, 12, 25.
For affecting digital Zm-inputs/outputs, see IEC 617-12, Section 17.

symbols.description: When this input takes its internal 1-state, the analogue outputs hold their values; in the 0-state it has no effect.
Not-equal output of a comparator.
notes: The asterisks shall be replaced by designations of the quantities or operands compared.

symbols.name_fr: Sortie « plus grand que » d'un comparateur
symbols.description: Greater-than output of a comparator. Use symbol 12-09-30 of IEC 617-12.

symbols.name_fr: Sortie « plus petit que » d'un comparateur
symbols.description: Less-than output of a comparator. Use symbol 12-09-31 of IEC 617-12.
Equal output of a comparator. Use symbol 12-09-32 of IEC 617-12.
If an Mm-input stands at its internal 1-state, affected inputs/outputs are enabled (have their normally defined effect/level).

If an Mm-input/output stands at its internal 0-state, affected inputs have no effect and affected output label-sets containing its identifying number are ignored (disabling multi-function inputs/outputs).

Effect on affected inputs is the same as an Mm-input (13-05-21); on digital outputs the same as an EN-input (12-09-11 of IEC 617-12); for analogue outputs, the output has its normal function/level only when ENm is at internal 1-state.
Xm-input (interconnection/dependency input).
Xm-output. See IEC 617-12, Section 17A.

symbols.name_fr: Opérateur de fonctions mathématiques, symbole général
symbols.description: Function-computing element. Replace f(x1,...,xb) by an indication of/reference to the function (e.g. IEC 27-1) and the arguments. The solidus shall not be used to indicate division. Illustrations: multiplier, multiplier-divider, cotangent, exponential.
Example: multiplier (X1−X2)(Y1−Y2)/10 [V], device AD532D.
notes: Symbol 13-07-02 depicts the same device performing another function.

symbols.description: Example: squarer X²/10 [V], device AD532D.
notes: Symbol 13-07-01 depicts the same device performing another function.

symbols.description: Amplifier, general symbol (Form 3). f may be replaced by a qualifying symbol for an additional function: Σ summing, ∫ integration, d/dt differentiation, exp exponentiation, log logarithm, SH sample-and-hold. m is the common amplification factor. For forms 1 and 2 see symbols 10-15-01 and 10-15-02 of IEC 617-10.

05.en: Qualifying symbols indicating the functions of inputs, outputs and other connections
05.fr: Symboles distinctifs indiquant les fonctions des accès et autres connexions

07.en: Examples of elements performing mathematical functions
07.fr: Exemples d'opérateurs réalisant des fonctions mathématiques
